guarantees.claim: Instance gen_prd_extract_assert exists only when WidthPRDSBox > 8

uncertain_points.claim: The internal logic of gen_prd_extract_assert is not shown; it is intended to prevent overlapping extraction of PRD for data masks and key expand/SubBytes feeds, but its actual enforcement is unknown.
